text: Hello everyone, welcome back to my class.In the last period, we had a deeper understanding of the passage entitled The Next Big Thing.In today's class, we will focus on vocabulary building.At the end of this period, you are expected to group words and expressions into categories based on the topic.Use topic-related vocabulary to introduce new technologies and express your own attitude towards them.Describe your vision of new technologies in 2035 in the mini project by using the words learned.Please get your textbook and worksheet ready.In the previous lesson, by reading the text, we got familiar with three emerging technologies, mobile social networking, video phone hardware, and AR.At the beginning of this lesson, to help you better visualize their development, I will introduce a chart of product life cycle to you.The horizontal axis or the x-axis is the product from cradle to grave during a certain period, while the vertical axis or the y-axis indicates popularity.The chart begins with a technology making its appearance in the market, namely the introduction of a technology.If it survives and continues to thrive, meeting the market needs, it will enter the growth stage.As the technology matures, it will attract more prospective users.However, not every dog has its day.Weaker products will eventually exit the stage.As for the three emerging technologies mentioned in the passage, which stage does each technology fall into?Introduction, growth, maturity, or decline?Please read the sentences from the text, and figure out the answers with the help of some key words and expressions we learned in the previous lessons.You will have 30 seconds for it.Okay, here is my answer with supporting details.Mobile social networking must be in the stage of maturity, because the phrase have legs means continue to exist and succeed.Telephone hardware may fall into the stage of decline, because fateful means having a great effect on the future, and through here means finished.AR should be in the stage of growth, because the word adolescent means young.These key words and expressions are very helpful in describing a technology in different stages of development.Now please find more words and phrases the writer used in the passage, and group them into introduction, growth, maturity, and decline stages respectively.You will have two minutes for the task.Okay, I will share with you the words and expressions I found.We can use surface, come along, primitive, premature, faint outline, and newborn to describe the stage of introduction.And besides adolescent, full of potential can be put in the stage of growth.When we describe maturity, we can use have legs, fateful, and popular.Finally, be through, poorly made, and close down can be used to describe a declining technology.All these words can help you better describe the development of the new technology.Let me give you more explanation on some of them.First, let's look at the word surface.Surface here is not used as a noun, but a verb.When something such as a piece of news, a feeling, or a problem surfaces, it becomes known or obvious.In Chinese, 显现.For example, when this new technology surfaces, it is certain to cause conflict.The second one is come along.Come along means make an appearance, 出现.By using come along in the text, the author indicates that the like button doesn't appear until several years later.We can also use the phrase come along in the sentence.The issue discussed at the conference came along quite well, to denote the same meaning.Now, can you try to translate the following sentence into English?You will have 20 seconds.Okay.Here is my translation.A popular technological project will come along with a good opportunity.Well, let's look at the word premature in the introduction stage.The prefix pre means before.It is often used in front of verbs, nouns, and adjectives.For example, pre-heat, 预热,precaution, 预防.The word premature is usually used to describe something that happens before the natural or proper time.In Chinese, 不成熟的,提早的.Besides the text vocabulary, can you brainstorm more?Please write down more words and phrases with similar meanings in each stage, and choose one in each group to make a sentence.You will have four minutes to finish activity one on your worksheet.Okay, Jennifer, can you share your work with us?As for the introduction part, I have written arise, come up, spring up, and be in its infancy.For example, I can use arise in a sentence.A new facial recognition technology arises for the purpose of tracking customers and promoting sales.Good.How about the second one?John?In the stage of growth, I think promising, perspective, ascend, and make progress share the same meaning.For example, the perspective wearable devices that can store health data have drawn great attention in the past 10 years.What have you written in the maturity stage, Carol?I think an instant success, a great hit, gain popularity, and a catch-on belong to the maturity stage.For example, the word catch-on in a sentence, the dog-like robotic dogs have caught on for ages, for they keep elderly people company without bringing any troubles.Finally, what about the declining stage?Bonnie?I may use for short of expectation, plunge, descend, or outdated to describe the falling stage.Here's my sentence.The Walkman, an outdated product, has been criticized for its limited storage capacity and single function.Well done.These words and phrases are worthy of note, because they are quite helpful in describing the stages that a technology is likely to experience.Now, do you want to try?Let's have a practice.Please choose at least two words in the categories and introduce an emerging technology in one or two sentences.The following pictures can serve as a reference.You will have one minute.Okay, please share your introduction with us.First, John, what is your introduction?The technology of drones first came along in the military field.Later on, when it was introduced into people's daily life, it turned out to have legs.Now, let's welcome Jennifer to share her idea with us.Well, these emerging technologies are truly amazing, aren't they?However, people have divided attitudes toward them.For example, in the text, the writer considers the technology to be a tool for self-development and self-improvement.In the text, the writer considers the technology to be a tool for self-improvement and self-improvement.In the text, the writer considers mobile social networking stupid, showing her disapproval of it.However, her mother, as a futurist, can always see beyond the primitive version, which means she has great confidence in this emerging technology.Then, how about your attitude towards new technologies?How will you talk about your attitude?When we talk about our attitude, we may hold an approving, disapproving or indifferent attitude.Now, please finish activity two on your worksheet.Read the sentences on your worksheet, underline the expressions showing attitudes, and classify them into three different groups.Okay, let's take a look at it.If we approve of the issue, we can use expressions likeI am in favor of, I am enthusiastic about, and I hold a favorable opinion.By saying I am cautious about, I can use expressions likeI am in favor of, I am enthusiastic about, and I hold a favorable opinion.By saying I am cautious about, I am against, or I object to, we show a disapproving attitude.When we are indifferent to the issue, we can say I am neutral towards, or I am unconcerned about.Okay, have you got it?Let's put them into practice.Emergent technologies have brought great changes to us human beings, and turn up in every field of our life.Now, please choose one emergent technology in any of the following domains, and introduce it to your classmates.Your introduction should contain the following elements.Description of its product life cycle, its functions, your attitude towards it, and your reasons.And please try to use some words and phrases you have learned today.You can use your worksheet for reference.You will have one minute to prepare.Okay, please share your introduction with the class.First, let's welcome Carol.Space travel is in its growth stage.I think it's a prime example of space travel, and space travel is also a prime example of space travel.Please share your introduction with the class.I think it's a promising technology, and very likely to succeed in the future.It can take people to space to have a glimpse of what our Mother Earth looks like.Since the idea of space travel has legs, I hold a favorable opinion about space travel.The technology has made progress in the past decades, because some countries have sent their astronauts to space.Dan, can you introduce your emerging technology to us?Immersive learning is in its maturity stage.With the fast development of VR and AR, the technology is a great hit among adolescents, because they can acquire knowledge anywhere as if they were in the classroom.I'm totally in favor of this technology.Although some problems may come along, scientists are sure to improve it, and I believe it will never fall short of people's expectations.OK, thanks for sharing.Obviously, emerging technologies are everywhere in our life, making our life better than before and reshaping our way of life.Whether they succeed or fail, their existence enables us to pursue a better future.Here is the assignment for today.Mini project.Imagine your life in the year of 2035.New technologies have brought great changes to your life.Please write an essay on the next big thing in your eyes in 100 to 120 words.Your writing should answer these questions.One, what can people do with it?Two, in what ways do you think it would make your life different from now?Three, can you predict its product life cycle in 2035?Four, what is your attitude towards the technology and why?Please try to use the words and phrases you have learned in this section.They are desirable resources for language learners.Then, interactive tasks.Please comment on one emerging technology your classmates introduced and express your attitude towards it.That's the end of reading and interaction section.Thank you for your time with me.Bye bye.
